test_name: BOAR low-voltage diagnostic bring-up: one r0p0 burst per approved voltage
scope: diagnostic only; output is not grid-campaign characterization evidence
optional one burst at 15 V and optional one burst at 20 V only after signed review of the preceding clean step
direct logic capture of PB12/SD1, PD2/SD2 and PB6
scope capture CH1=ACS712 U, CH2=ACS712 V, external trigger PB6
no FOC, V/f, autotune, retry after fault, 60 V operation or full grid campaign
prerequisites: Previous 60 V campaign attempts are closed BLOCKED and their evidence is immutable
Production default-deny is installed before preparation
Motor open-winding phase order and winding continuity independently checked
ACS712 U/V series wiring and continuity independently checked
Scope single-shot covers at least 2 ms before and 5 ms after PB6 falling edge
Logic capture includes PB12/SD1, PD2/SD2 and PB6
Supply current plus CC/CV state and both STEVAL fault LEDs are observed
stop_conditions: any FAULT_R=18 or other firmware fault
SD1 or SD2 low at any time in the captured window
supply enters current limit or trips
unexpected motion, noise, heating, smoke or smell
loss of observation by either person
notes: Current limit defaults to 1 A for diagnostic bring-up; approver may lower it. Raising it requires a new reviewed G0.
